headline: Apple ordered to pay nearly $60 million in Brazil over loot boxes
summary: A Brazilian court has ordered Apple and several other companies to pay nearly $60 million over loot boxes in games accessible to minors.
details: A Brazilian court has mandated Apple and several other companies to pay a collective fine of nearly $60 million. This significant penalty addresses the issue of loot boxes found in games that are accessible to minors within the country.
